title: PCSO Lotto Results: No winners of P357-M Grand Lotto jackpot on Nov. 11
summary: It's better luck next time for bettors gunning for the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of over P357 million after no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 11, 2026, the…

blocks.text: It's better luck next time for bettors gunning for the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize of over P357 million after no winners were announced in any of the major lotto jackpot draws on November 11, 2026, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) said Wednesday.
The Grand Lotto jackpot of P357,001,590.56 was left untouched after no one selected the correct combination of 19-04-27-54-22-48.
The last time someone won the Grand Lotto jackpot was on March 9, 2026, when a single bettor from Negros Occidental, a seafarer, took home the P45 million prize.
There were also no winners for Megalotto 6/45 whose numbers of 25-37-01-44-10-31 would have translated to a P15,000,000 jackpot.
Check here for the complete lotto results. —RF, GMA News
